summary: Iteration 22 — Admin inventory upload & management. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests PASS after fixing stale Prisma client. Frontend: data-testids all present, navigation works, history table populated, but two functional issues found: filter-query does not filter the list, and manual entry form submission silently fails (no redirect, no error displayed).

ui_bugs.issue: filter-query input does not filter rows. Typing 'TEST_TOYOTA' kept all 128 rows visible. Likely the search query is not wired to the API call or client-side filter.

Submitting the manual entry form with valid required fields (make=TEST_PW_MAZDA, model=CX5_pw, year=2024, price=2750000) does not redirect to /admin/inventory?created=<id> and no error is shown. Backend API works (verified via pytest). Form likely not converting price to integer cents, OR onSubmit handler not awaiting fetch, OR validation fails silently. URL stays at /admin/inventory/new?

action_items: FIX: /admin/inventory filter-query input is not wired up — InventoryListClient should send the typed query as ?q= or filter client-side via state. Currently typing has no effect.

FIX: /admin/inventory/new form submit silently fails. Likely the price field is sent as a string/number instead of integer cents, or the onSubmit handler is not awaiting the response, or validation fails silently. Add visible error display + verify priceCents conversion (UI shows 'e.g. 35000' implying dollars but the API expects cents).

INFO: A stale Prisma client (missing the 'condition' field) was causing 500s on POST /api/admin/inventory. Ran `npx prisma generate` + restarted frontend supervisor — now resolved. Main agent should ensure CI/build also runs prisma generate before next deploy.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG (now fixed by regenerating client): Prisma client must be regenerated after schema changes — the build pipeline should run `prisma generate` automatically.

POST /api/admin/inventory accepts priceCents in cents but the manual entry form placeholder is 'e.g. 35000' which suggests dollars. Verify NewInventoryClient multiplies dollars × 100 before POST, or change placeholder to clarify cents.
InventoryListClient: confirm the filter-query state is included in the API query string or in the client-side filter predicate; current behavior shows it is ignored.
All inventory routes correctly enforce admin_token via getAdminFromRequest — 401 returned consistently.
